model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's studio photo of the current HoverPro 450 (model 02616, Honda GCVx170) and are approximate. Fly Mow 1 (2018) has no model or serial recorded and may be an earlier 02602, 02603 or 02609: read the plate, because the engine, oil quantity, plug and air filter differ. The impeller, cutting disc and line sit under the deck and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts catalogs 3448-500 (02616) and 3391-143 (02602) and operator's manual 3459-573.

deck.name: Hover deck
deck.desc: Deck assembly 111-6003 (02616) or 111-6921 (02602). The impeller and cutting disc run under the deck. After use: clean clippings and dirt off the whole machine.

intake.name: Air intake ring
intake.desc: Ring at the engine base on top of the deck, over the impeller H192268. Keep it clear of clippings when cleaning the machine after use.

impeller.name: Impeller
impeller.desc: Impeller H192268 (same number in the 02602 and 02616 catalogs). Inspect it with the cutting disc whenever the line or height is changed.

disc.name: Cutting disc (Safeway)
disc.desc: Safeway cutting disc H292401: replace if cracked or damaged. Hardware: two aluminium blade spacers H192025, blade retainer H192272, set screw H292018. Each spacer changes the height of cut by 6.3 mm: record the spacer positions. Check the disc assembly every time the line or height is changed. Never fit metal cutting parts. The old Notion numbers 108-8127 and 108-8126 are Briggs parts, not disc parts.

line.name: Cutting line
line.desc: 3.5 mm Flexiblade line: 27 m pack H292385 or 143 m spool H292384. Replace yearly, more often if worn, in two equal lengths of Toro line. There are no plastic blades (Notion's 108-8140-03 is wrong).

engine.name: Engine: Honda GCVx170 (02616)
engine.desc: 02616: Honda GCVx170 (Toro engine part 134-6432). Earlier 02602: Honda engine, Toro part 111-7163. Oil 10W-30, API SJ or higher, 0.40 L (02602: 0.59 L). Change at the first 5 h, then every 25 h (the 02602 manual says yearly). Daily: oil level. Fuel: fresh unleaded, 91 RON minimum, no more than 10% ethanol, under 30 days old, stabiliser recommended. 02602 only: clean the engine and starter cooling fins yearly and drain the fuel before storage. Engine parts come from a Honda dealer by engine type and serial: the old Notion GX160 parts are for the wrong engine.

airfilter.name: Air filter
airfilter.desc: Replace yearly, more often in dust. 02616: Honda element, not in the Toro catalog; get it from a Honda dealer by engine type and serial. 02602 only: Toro 132-0369 (toro.com US list USD 8.36).

plug.name: Spark plug
plug.desc: 02616: Champion RN9YC, gap 0.76 mm, check every 100 h and replace if needed. 02602 only: Toro 131-8231 (NGK). The old Notion NGK BPR6ES entry is wrong for the 02616.

fuelcap.name: Fuel cap
fuelcap.desc: Fill with fresh unleaded (91 RON minimum, no more than 10% ethanol, under 30 days old); stabiliser recommended.

muffler.name: Muffler guard
muffler.desc: Guard over the engine muffler. Honda engine part: source by engine type and serial.

handleU.name: Upper handle
handleU.desc: Upper handle carrying the stop bail and grips. Clamped to the lower handle with the handle knobs.

handleL.name: Lower handle
handleL.desc: Lower handle bolted to the deck mounts, joined to the upper handle at the handle knobs.

bail.name: Stop bail (operator presence)
bail.desc: Daily: the engine must stop within 3 seconds of releasing the bail. If it does not, check the bail and its cable before use.

cable.name: Stop cable
cable.desc: Cable from the stop bail to the engine. If the engine does not stop within 3 seconds of releasing the bail, check this cable before use.

knobs.name: Handle knobs
knobs.desc: Clamp knobs joining the upper and lower handles. Keep them tight.

mount.name: Handle mount
mount.desc: Bracket on the deck where the lower handle bolts on.

H292384.name: Cutting line 3.5 mm, 143 m spool
H292384.note: Bulk spool; 27 m pack is H292385.

H192025.name: Aluminium blade spacer (x2)
H192025.note: Each spacer changes height of cut by 6.3 mm.

134-6432.name: Engine, Honda GCVx170 (02616)
134-6432.note: Toro engine part number. Honda parts via a Honda dealer.
